note: Fan-imagined perfumes from a creator's 'fragrances that don't exist but should' post. They are not real products. For each one, the atlas suggests real scents with similar notes.

items.name: Soft Wood (eau de parfum)
items.idea: The Soft Wood body mist, but as a longer-lasting perfume.

items.name: You Bonheur
items.idea: A happier, brighter take on Glossier You with bergamot, lily of the valley and water jasmine.

items.name: Jungle Gym
items.idea: A fresh, green gym scent that never offends: ylang-ylang, cedar, cypress and vetiver.

items.name: Me & You
items.idea: A stronger version of Snif's Me with pink pepper, almond and tuberose.

items.name: Secret Scent 24
items.idea: A mystery perfume whose notes are never revealed: light, airy and a little sweet.

items.name: Cosmic flanker
items.idea: Milky and sunny, like coconut milk poured over white flowers.

items.name: Milky Ways
items.idea: Cold milk, a metallic edge, salt, soft flowers and incense: a space-age skin scent.

items.name: Lost Boys
items.idea: A deeper, more masculine cousin of Missing Person: incense, leather, woods, musk and apricot skin.

items.name: Vanilla Paradiso
items.idea: A fruity vanilla dessert: vanilla icing with tropical fruit and dark berries.

items.name: Water lily eau de parfum
items.idea: Water lily with soft flowers, watery notes and warm musk.

items.name: Just Breathe
items.idea: A calm, spa-like unisex scent: eucalyptus, frankincense, cedar, soft musk and salt.
